title: Iron Canvas Score
description: A declarative motion score performed by runtime/canvas-score.js — and the motion contract every agent and the critic read (references/cinematic-score.md). Acts map to page sections; shots place verbs on each act's timeline. Contract fields (stage, job, role, emotion, reduced, fallback, signature) are ignored by the runtime and enforced by scripts/ic-preflight.mjs.

logline.description: One sentence: what the viewer should feel by the end.

register.description: Contract: the Treatment Register this score was written for (sets the motion-sentence length and the quiet-between-loud rule).

surface.description: Contract: the surface pack (mobile pin rules differ by pack).

tempo.description: Multiplies durations of enter/load acts. contemplative > 1, fast < 1.

seed.description: Seeds breath phases so every run renders identically.

smooth.description: Lenis smooth scroll in full mode.

signature.description: Contract: the id of the one act whose role is 'signature'.

el.description: CSS selector of the act's section.

stage.description: Contract: the act's beat in the motion sentence.

job.description: Contract: what the section does for the visitor.

role.description: Contract: exactly one act per score is the signature.

intent.description: What this act makes the viewer feel. Documentation for humans and critics; not performed.

emotion.description: Contract: the feeling on arrival and on leaving, in words a person would use.

reduced.description: Contract: what the settled, still frame means under reduced motion.

fallback.description: Contract: what shows without WebGL or on a slow network.

mobile.description: Contract: the semantic mobile transformation when a pinned act cannot pin on phones.

length.description: Scrub acts: scroll distance, e.g. '180%' (of viewport height).

hold.description: Seconds of stillness appended so a pinned act rests on its final frame.

at.description: Seconds on the act timeline (proportional in scrub acts).

call.description: Name of a hook passed in options.hooks — fired when the playhead reaches 'at'.

note.description: Director's note — why this shot exists.
